--- title: "Welcome to Stats Rsenal" author: "Dominik Schulz" date: "2026-04-23" categories: [news, code] --- ![](thumbnail.jpg) Welcome to **Stats Rsenal**! Starting a blog on data analysis with a focus on R programming has been a long-time idea of mine. However, due to other obligations the realization was postponed time and time again. Nonetheless, now it is finally time to start this project and bring the joy of data analysis to the world. On a more or less regular basis (maybe on a weekly or biweekly schedule), we will share with you posts teaching about R programming, applied statistics and machine learning, and probability theory. If we have ongoing and motivating in-depth projects, we intend to share those, too. Please feel free to learn more about us and **Stats Rsenal** following the **About** pages, and reach out, if you have feedback on our posts. Stay tuned for exciting updates! With that being said, what better way is there to start such a blog than with the most popular words in the world of programming? ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} print("Hello, World!") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] "Hello, World!" ``` ::: ::: Best,
Dominik Schulz
